newsitem.title: USA: ProNet to pay added $400,000 in pact.
newsitem.headline: ProNet to pay added $400,000 in pact.

text.p: ProNet Inc said Wednesday that it had reached an an agreement with its former underwriters relating to pending class actions suits pending against the company in state and federal courts in Dallas.

ProNet said it will pay an additional $400,000 toward the previously announced settlement with the class plaintiffs and that the underwriters will pay $1.85 million to the class plaintiffs under the terms of the pact.

The company disclosed in May that Lehman Bros Holdings Inc, the lead underwriter, had sued it seeking indemnification and recovery of legal costs to defend against suits filed against ProNet and its underwriters.
ProNet said Wednesday that the pact ends its potential liability to its former underwriters and should also end its potential liability to class plaintiffs.

Plaintiffs had alleged that the company, which provides wireless communication services, schemed with insiders and an investment banker to inflate the price of its stock in order to affect numerous acquisitions.
ProNet said the proposed class settlement is subject to execution of a definitive settlement pact by all of the parties and is subject to court approval.
